title: Fill a form is now part of Surveys & Quizzes
description: The sidebar had one row for building surveys and another, Fill a form, for answering them. They are now one Surveys & Quizzes row. If you only answer forms, that row opens the ones waiting on you.
items: Team leaders and department admins get To answer and Manage under it
Links you already have to a form still work
To answer now separates what is waiting on you from what you have already answered, and a form you have answered no longer opens a dead end
A form shows how many questions it has and marks which are required, and sending it gives you a way back to the list
